spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT a.*, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'min_cohort') AS min_cohort, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'off_protocol_pct') AS off_protocol_pct_line
FROM report_adherence_summary('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a
WHERE a.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT s.*
FROM report_adherence_steps('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) s
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: The Excel protocol adherence table. Each patient is counted once, by the BP medicines at their latest visit. Came back counts patients seen in the last 3 months. Controlled means BP under 140/90 at that visit. Hover a percent to see its count.
spec.title: Patients by protocol step

spec.rawSql:
WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT a.*, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'min_cohort') AS min_cohort,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'off_protocol_pct') AS off_protocol_pct_line, (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'one_medicine_pct') AS one_medicine_pct_line,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_adherence_summary('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'
